title.zh: 第 2 章 参数方程与极坐标
title.en: Chapter 2 Parametric Equations and Polar Coordinates

title.zh: 参数曲线
title.en: Parametric Curves

points.zh: 定义 2.1（平面曲线）：平面曲线可由一对参数方程 $x = f(t),\ y = g(t),\ t \in [a,b]$ 给出。
points.en: Definition 2.1 (Plane Curves): a plane curve is defined by a pair of parametric equations $x = f(t),\ y = g(t),\ t \in [a,b]$.

points.zh: $P(x(a),y(a))$ 与 $Q(x(b),y(b))$ 分别称为曲线的起点与终点。
points.en: $P(x(a),y(a))$ and $Q(x(b),y(b))$ are called the initial and terminal points of the curve.

points.zh: 若 $P$ 与 $Q$ 是同一点，则称该曲线为闭曲线。
points.en: If $P$ and $Q$ are the same point, the curve is called a closed curve.

points.zh: 若不同的 $t$ 值给出平面上的不同点（除可能的 $t=a$ 与 $t=b$ 外），则称该曲线为简单曲线。
points.en: If distinct values of $t$ yield distinct points in the plane, except possibly for $t=a$ and $t=b$, the curve is called simple.

points.zh: 消去参数法：由 $x=f(t),\ y=g(t)$ 解出 $t$ 再代入另一个方程；例 2.1 中 $x=t^2+2t,\ y=t$ 给出 $x=y^2+2y$。
points.en: Eliminating the parameter: solve $x=f(t),\ y=g(t)$ for $t$ and substitute into the other equation; in Example 2.1, $x=t^2+2t,\ y=t$ gives $x=y^2+2y$.

points.zh: 例 2.2：$x=2\cos t,\ y=2\sin t,\ 0 \le t \le \pi$ 表示圆 $x^2+y^2=4$ 的上半部分。
points.en: Example 2.2: $x=2\cos t,\ y=2\sin t,\ 0 \le t \le \pi$ describes the upper half of the circle $x^2+y^2=4$.

points.zh: 例 2.3：(a) $x=\sqrt{1-t^2},\ y=t,\ -1 \le t \le 1$；(b) $x=\cos t,\ y=\sin t,\ -\dfrac{\pi}{2} \le t \le \dfrac{\pi}{2}$；(c) $x=\dfrac{1-t^2}{1+t^2},\ y=\dfrac{2t}{1+t^2},\ -1 \le t \le 1$，三者的图象相同（单位圆的右半圆）。
points.en: Example 2.3: (a) $x=\sqrt{1-t^2},\ y=t,\ -1 \le t \le 1$; (b) $x=\cos t,\ y=\sin t,\ -\dfrac{\pi}{2} \le t \le \dfrac{\pi}{2}$; (c) $x=\dfrac{1-t^2}{1+t^2},\ y=\dfrac{2t}{1+t^2},\ -1 \le t \le 1$ — all three have the same graph (the right half of the unit circle).

title.zh: 极坐标
title.en: Polar Coordinates

points.zh: 设 $P(x,y)$ 为坐标平面上一点，令 $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ 为 $P$ 到原点 $O$ 的距离，$\theta$ 为 $OP$ 与正 $x$ 轴所成的角，则 $(r,\theta)$ 称为 $P$ 的极坐标。
points.en: For a point $P(x,y)$, let $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ be its distance from the origin $O$ and let $\theta$ be the angle that $OP$ makes with the positive $x$-axis; then $(r,\theta)$ are the polar coordinates of $P$.

points.zh: 直角坐标与极坐标的互化公式：$x = r\cos\theta,\ y = r\sin\theta$。
points.en: Conversion formulas: $x = r\cos\theta,\ y = r\sin\theta$.

points.zh: 正 $x$ 轴称为极轴，原点 $O$ 称为极点。
points.en: The positive $x$-axis is called the polar axis and $O$ is called the pole.

points.zh: 把定义推广到 $r$ 可以为负：$(-r,\theta)$ 与 $(r,\theta+\pi)$ 表示同一点。
points.en: The definition is generalised so that $r$ may be negative: $(-r,\theta)$ and $(r,\theta+\pi)$ represent the same point.

points.zh: 平面上的一点有无穷多个极坐标表示（见讲义中 $(1,\dfrac{5\pi}{4})$、$(1,-\dfrac{3\pi}{4})$、$(1,\dfrac{13\pi}{4})$、$(-1,\dfrac{\pi}{4})$ 的图示）。
points.en: A point in the plane can be represented by infinitely many polar coordinates (see the notes for $(1,\dfrac{5\pi}{4})$, $(1,-\dfrac{3\pi}{4})$, $(1,\dfrac{13\pi}{4})$, $(-1,\dfrac{\pi}{4})$).

points.zh: 例 2.5：(i) 极坐标 $\left(4,\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right)$ 的直角坐标为 $(2\sqrt{3},2)$；(ii) 直角坐标 $(-3,\sqrt{3})$ 的极坐标为 $\left(2\sqrt{3},\dfrac{5\pi}{6}\right)$。
points.en: Example 2.5: (i) the Cartesian coordinates of $\left(4,\dfrac{\pi}{6}\right)$ are $(2\sqrt{3},2)$; (ii) the polar coordinates of $(-3,\sqrt{3})$ are $\left(2\sqrt{3},\dfrac{5\pi}{6}\right)$.

title.zh: 极坐标曲线
title.en: Curves in Polar Coordinates

points.zh: 例 2.6：极曲线 $r=1$ 是以极点为圆心、半径为 $1$ 的圆。
points.en: Example 2.6: the polar curve $r=1$ is the circle of radius $1$ centred at the pole.

points.zh: 例 2.7：极曲线 $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{4}$ 是过极点、与正 $x$ 轴成 $\dfrac{\pi}{4}$ 角的射线所在的直线。
points.en: Example 2.7: the polar curve $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{4}$ is the line through the pole making an angle $\dfrac{\pi}{4}$ with the positive $x$-axis.
Example 2.8: $r = 8\sin\theta$ gives $r^2 = 8r\sin\theta$, i.e. $x^2+y^2=8y$, hence $x^2+(y-4)^2=16$: a circle with centre $(0,4)$ and radius $4$.
Example 2.9: $r = 8\cos\theta$ gives $x^2+y^2=8x$, hence $(x-4)^2+y^2=16$: a circle with centre $(4,0)$ and radius $4$.

points.zh: 直线的极坐标方程形式为 $r=\dfrac{d}{\cos(\theta-\theta_0)}$。
points.en: The polar equation of a line has the form $r=\dfrac{d}{\cos(\theta-\theta_0)}$.

points.zh: 过极点的圆，若圆心的极坐标为 $(a,\theta_0)$，其极坐标方程为 $r = 2a\cos(\theta-\theta_0)$。
points.en: If a circle passes through the pole and its centre has polar coordinates $(a,\theta_0)$, its polar equation is $r = 2a\cos(\theta-\theta_0)$.

points.zh: 常见曲线族：$r=a\pm b\cos\theta$ 与 $r=a\pm b\sin\theta$ 为 limacon（$a=b$ 时为心脏线 cardioid）；$r^2=\pm a\cos 2\theta$ 与 $r^2=\pm a\sin 2\theta$ 为双纽线 lemniscate；$r=a\cos n\theta$ 与 $r=a\sin n\theta$ 为玫瑰线 rose（$n$ 为奇数时 $n$ 瓣，$n$ 为偶数时 $2n$ 瓣）；$r=a\theta$ 为阿基米德螺线。
points.en: Standard families: $r=a\pm b\cos\theta$ and $r=a\pm b\sin\theta$ are limaçons (cardioids when $a=b$); $r^2=\pm a\cos 2\theta$ and $r^2=\pm a\sin 2\theta$ are lemniscates; $r=a\cos n\theta$ and $r=a\sin n\theta$ are roses ($n$ leaves for odd $n$, $2n$ leaves for even $n$); $r=a\theta$ is the spiral of Archimedes.

title.zh: 参数曲线的定义与三个基本概念
title.en: Definition and the Three Basic Notions of a Parametric Curve

body.zh: 平面曲线由参数方程 $x=f(t),\ y=g(t),\ t \in [a,b]$ 定义：$t$ 是参数，$P(x(a),y(a))$ 是起点，$Q(x(b),y(b))$ 是终点。若 $P=Q$ 则曲线是闭曲线；若除 $t=a$ 与 $t=b$ 外不同的 $t$ 给出不同的点，则曲线是简单曲线。理解曲线的走向必须同时记住参数 $t$ 的取值区间。
body.en: A plane curve is defined by the parametric equations $x=f(t),\ y=g(t),\ t \in [a,b]$: $t$ is the parameter, $P(x(a),y(a))$ is the initial point and $Q(x(b),y(b))$ is the terminal point. If $P=Q$ the curve is closed; if distinct values of $t$ (apart from $t=a$ and $t=b$) give distinct points, the curve is simple. The range of the parameter must always be kept in mind when tracing the curve.

title.zh: 消去参数法
title.en: Eliminating the Parameter

body.zh: 消去参数就是把两个方程中的 $t$ 消掉：若一个方程能解出 $t$（如例 2.1 的 $y=t$），则代入另一个方程；否则用 $t^2$、$t^3$ 等幂次配合（例如 $x=t^2,\ y=t^3$ 给出 $x^3=t^6=y^2$）。消参后必须补上由 $t$ 的范围带来的取值限制，否则会画出多余的分支。
body.en: Eliminating the parameter means removing $t$ from the two equations: if one of them can be solved for $t$ (as in Example 2.1, $y=t$), substitute it into the other; otherwise use powers such as $t^2$ and $t^3$ (e.g. $x=t^2,\ y=t^3$ gives $x^3=t^6=y^2$). After eliminating, the restriction coming from the range of $t$ must be added back, otherwise extra branches get drawn.

title.zh: 同一条曲线的不同参数方程
title.en: Different Parametric Equations for the Same Curve

body.zh: 例 2.3 中 (a) $x=\sqrt{1-t^2},\ y=t,\ -1 \le t \le 1$；(b) $x=\cos t,\ y=\sin t,\ -\dfrac{\pi}{2} \le t \le \dfrac{\pi}{2}$；(c) $x=\dfrac{1-t^2}{1+t^2},\ y=\dfrac{2t}{1+t^2},\ -1 \le t \le 1$ 给出同一条曲线（单位圆的右半圆）。参数化方式不同，图象相同；求参数方程时可以用三角函数，也可以用有理参数（如分角线法）。
body.en: In Example 2.3, (a) $x=\sqrt{1-t^2},\ y=t,\ -1 \le t \le 1$; (b) $x=\cos t,\ y=\sin t,\ -\dfrac{\pi}{2} \le t \le \dfrac{\pi}{2}$; (c) $x=\dfrac{1-t^2}{1+t^2},\ y=\dfrac{2t}{1+t^2},\ -1 \le t \le 1$ all describe the same curve (the right half of the unit circle). Different parameterisations give the same graph; trigonometric or rational parameterisations (e.g. the half-angle substitution) are both acceptable.

title.zh: 圆与椭圆的参数方程
title.en: Parametric Equations for Circles and Ellipses

body.zh: 由 $\cos^2 t + \sin^2 t = 1$ 得 $\dfrac{x-h}{a}=\cos t,\ \dfrac{y-k}{b}=\sin t$，即 $x=h+a\cos t,\ y=k+b\sin t$。当 $a=b$ 时是半径为 $a$、圆心 $(h,k)$ 的圆；当 $a \neq b$ 时是半轴为 $a,b$、中心 $(h,k)$ 的椭圆（例 2.4 与习题 2.4）。
body.en: From $\cos^2 t + \sin^2 t = 1$ we get $\dfrac{x-h}{a}=\cos t,\ \dfrac{y-k}{b}=\sin t$, i.e. $x=h+a\cos t,\ y=k+b\sin t$. When $a=b$ this is the circle of radius $a$ centred at $(h,k)$; when $a \neq b$ it is the ellipse with semi-axes $a,b$ centred at $(h,k)$ (Example 2.4 and Exercise 2.4).

title.zh: 双曲线的参数方程
title.en: Parametric Equations for Hyperbolas

body.zh: 双曲线 $\dfrac{(x-h)^2}{a^2}-\dfrac{(y-k)^2}{b^2}=1$ 不能用 $\cos,\sin$ 参数化，因为 $\cos^2 t-\sin^2 t \le 1$。要用双曲函数：$\cosh t=\dfrac{e^t+e^{-t}}{2},\ \sinh t=\dfrac{e^t-e^{-t}}{2}$，且 $\cosh^2 t-\sinh^2 t=1$，于是 $x=h+a\cosh t,\ y=k+b\sinh t$；也可以用 $x=h+a\sec t,\ y=k+b\tan t$（利用 $\sec^2 t-\tan^2 t=1$）。
body.en: The hyperbola $\dfrac{(x-h)^2}{a^2}-\dfrac{(y-k)^2}{b^2}=1$ cannot be parameterised with $\cos,\sin$, because $\cos^2 t-\sin^2 t \le 1$. Use the hyperbolic functions: $\cosh t=\dfrac{e^t+e^{-t}}{2},\ \sinh t=\dfrac{e^t-e^{-t}}{2}$ with $\cosh^2 t-\sinh^2 t=1$, giving $x=h+a\cosh t,\ y=k+b\sinh t$; alternatively $x=h+a\sec t,\ y=k+b\tan t$ (using $\sec^2 t-\tan^2 t=1$).

title.zh: 极坐标的定义与记号
title.en: Definition and Notation of Polar Coordinates

body.zh: 对平面上的点 $P(x,y)$，令 $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ 为其到原点 $O$ 的距离，$\theta$ 为 $OP$ 与正 $x$ 轴所成的角，则 $(r,\theta)$ 为极坐标，并有关系 $x=r\cos\theta,\ y=r\sin\theta$。正 $x$ 轴是极轴，原点是极点。反过来由 $x,y$ 求极坐标时 $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$，$\theta$ 由 $\tan\theta=\dfrac{y}{x}$ 与点所在的象限共同确定。
body.en: For $P(x,y)$, let $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ be the distance to the origin $O$ and let $\theta$ be the angle that $OP$ makes with the positive $x$-axis; then $(r,\theta)$ are the polar coordinates, with $x=r\cos\theta,\ y=r\sin\theta$. The positive $x$-axis is the polar axis and the origin is the pole. To go back from $x,y$, use $r=\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ and determine $\theta$ from $\tan\theta=\dfrac{y}{x}$ together with the quadrant of the point.

title.zh: 负的 r 与极坐标的多重表示
title.en: Negative r and the Many Representations of a Point

body.zh: 讲义把极坐标的定义推广到 $r$ 可为负，图中给出 $(-r,\theta)$ 与 $(r,\theta+\pi)$ 表示同一点。因此平面上一点有无穷多个极坐标表示：例如 $(1,\dfrac{5\pi}{4})$、$(1,-\dfrac{3\pi}{4})$、$(1,\dfrac{13\pi}{4})$、$(-1,\dfrac{\pi}{4})$ 都表示同一点。画极曲线时允许 $r$ 取负值，曲线可能因此多出一支。
body.en: The notes generalise the definition so that $r$ may be negative: the diagrams show that $(-r,\theta)$ and $(r,\theta+\pi)$ represent the same point. Hence a point has infinitely many polar representations, e.g. $(1,\dfrac{5\pi}{4})$, $(1,-\dfrac{3\pi}{4})$, $(1,\dfrac{13\pi}{4})$ and $(-1,\dfrac{\pi}{4})$ all denote the same point. When sketching polar curves one must allow negative $r$, which can add a branch.

title.zh: 极曲线与直角方程的互换
title.en: Converting Between Polar and Cartesian Equations

body.zh: 把 $r = a\cos\theta$ 或 $r = a\sin\theta$ 形式的两边乘 $r$：$r^2 = a r\cos\theta = ax$ 或 $r^2 = a r\sin\theta = ay$，再用 $r^2=x^2+y^2$ 即可配平方读出圆心与半径。例如 $r=8\sin\theta$ 给出 $x^2+(y-4)^2=16$，$r=8\cos\theta$ 给出 $(x-4)^2+y^2=16$；习题 2.10 中 $r=6\sin\theta-4\cos\theta$ 给出 $(x+2)^2+(y-3)^2=13$。
body.en: For equations of the form $r = a\cos\theta$ or $r = a\sin\theta$, multiply by $r$: $r^2 = a r\cos\theta = ax$ or $r^2 = a r\sin\theta = ay$, then use $r^2=x^2+y^2$ and complete the square to read off the centre and radius. For example $r=8\sin\theta$ gives $x^2+(y-4)^2=16$, $r=8\cos\theta$ gives $(x-4)^2+y^2=16$, and in Exercise 2.10, $r=6\sin\theta-4\cos\theta$ gives $(x+2)^2+(y-3)^2=13$.

title.zh: 直线与过极点的圆的极坐标方程
title.en: Polar Equations of Lines and of Circles through the Pole

body.zh: 直线的极坐标方程形如 $r=\dfrac{d}{\cos(\theta-\theta_0)}$；若圆经过极点且圆心的极坐标为 $(a,\theta_0)$，则圆的极坐标方程为 $r = 2a\cos(\theta-\theta_0)$。这两个公式把「距极点的距离」和「方向角」直接编码进极坐标，便于快速作图。
body.en: The polar equation of a line has the form $r=\dfrac{d}{\cos(\theta-\theta_0)}$; if a circle passes through the pole and its centre has polar coordinates $(a,\theta_0)$, then its polar equation is $r = 2a\cos(\theta-\theta_0)$. These formulas encode the distance from the pole and the direction angle directly, which makes sketching quick.

title.zh: 求两曲线的交点
title.en: Finding Intersections of Two Curves

body.zh: 在极坐标下求交点要分两种情形：一是 $r=0$（极点），此时两条曲线都通过原点，交点就是 $(0,0)$；二是 $r\neq 0$，此时可以令两条极方程的右端相等（习题 2.16），或先化为直角方程再联立（习题 2.17 中 $3\cos\theta = 1+\cos\theta$）。只令两式相等会漏掉极点的交点。
body.en: Finding intersections in polar coordinates splits into two cases: first $r=0$ (the pole), where both curves pass through the origin and the intersection is $(0,0)$; second $r\neq 0$, where one may equate the right-hand sides of the two polar equations (Exercise 2.16) or convert to Cartesian equations and solve simultaneously (in Exercise 2.17, $3\cos\theta = 1+\cos\theta$). Equating the two expressions alone misses the intersection at the pole.

title.zh: 消参后忘记参数范围，画出多余分支
title.en: Forgetting the Range of the Parameter After Eliminating It

body.zh: 习题 2.2 中消去参数得 $y=1-x^2$ 后，如果不看 $0 \le t \le 16$，就会画出整条抛物线；正确图象只是 $0 \le x \le 4$ 的那一段，终点为 $(4,-15)$。每道消参题都要回头把 $t$ 的范围翻译成对 $x$（或 $y$）的约束。
body.en: In Exercise 2.2, after eliminating the parameter to get $y=1-x^2$, one would draw the whole parabola unless the condition $0 \le t \le 16$ is used; the correct graph is only the part with $0 \le x \le 4$, ending at $(4,-15)$. Always translate the range of $t$ into a constraint on $x$ (or $y$).

title.zh: 忽略 $x=t^2 \ge 0$ 只画了曲线的一半
title.en: Ignoring $x=t^2 \ge 0$ and Drawing Only Half the Curve

body.zh: 习题 2.1 中 $x=t^2$ 恒非负，所以 $x^3=y^2$ 这条半立方抛物线只在 $y$ 轴右侧出现，且 $0 \le x \le 4$。方程 $x^3=y^2$ 本身还有 $x<0$ 的左半支，那不在本题的参数范围内。
body.en: In Exercise 2.1, $x=t^2$ is always non-negative, so the curve $x^3=y^2$ appears only to the right of the $y$-axis with $0 \le x \le 4$. The equation $x^3=y^2$ itself also has a left branch with $x<0$, which is outside the given parameter range.

title.zh: 用错参数化双曲线
title.en: Using the Wrong Parametrisation for a Hyperbola

body.zh: 很多人会照搬圆的公式写成 $x=h+a\cos t,\ y=k+b\sin t$，但这样得到的是椭圆而不是双曲线（因为 $\cos^2 t+\sin^2 t=1$）。双曲线必须用 $\cosh$ 与 $\sinh$（或 $\sec$ 与 $\tan$），并且要给出参数范围 $\theta \in \mathbb{R}$。
body.en: A common mistake is to copy the circle formula $x=h+a\cos t,\ y=k+b\sin t$, which produces an ellipse, not a hyperbola (since $\cos^2 t+\sin^2 t=1$). A hyperbola requires $\cosh$ with $\sinh$ (or $\sec$ with $\tan$), together with the parameter range $\theta \in \mathbb{R}$.

title.zh: 把极坐标当成直角坐标用
title.en: Treating Polar Coordinates Like Cartesian Ones

body.zh: 在极坐标中 $r$ 是到极点的距离、$\theta$ 是与极轴的夹角，而不是坐标本身。由 $x,y$ 反求极坐标时，$r$ 一定是非负的 $\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$，而 $\theta$ 的象限必须由 $x,y$ 的符号判断；只写 $\theta=\arctan\dfrac{y}{x}$ 会丢掉象限信息。
body.en: In polar coordinates $r$ is a distance from the pole and $\theta$ an angle from the polar axis, not coordinates themselves. When converting back from $x,y$, $r$ is the non-negative $\sqrt{x^2+y^2}$ and the quadrant of $\theta$ must be read from the signs of $x,y$; writing only $\theta=\arctan\dfrac{y}{x}$ loses the quadrant.

title.zh: 不接受负的 r，或忘记 $(r,\theta)\equiv(-r,\theta+\pi)$
title.en: Rejecting Negative r, or Forgetting $(r,\theta)\equiv(-r,\theta+\pi)$

body.zh: 讲义明确把 $r$ 推广为可正可负，因此 $(-r,\theta)$ 与 $(r,\theta+\pi)$ 是同一点。同一平面点有无穷多个极坐标表示；若解题时强行要求 $r>0$，会漏掉极坐标曲线在某些方向上的那一支。
body.en: The notes explicitly allow $r$ to be positive or negative, so $(-r,\theta)$ and $(r,\theta+\pi)$ denote the same point and a point has infinitely many polar representations. Forcing $r>0$ would drop parts of a polar curve in some directions.

title.zh: 两边平方或约掉 r 时丢失了原点与符号条件
title.en: Squaring or Cancelling r Loses the Origin and Sign Conditions

body.zh: 由 $r = 4\sin\theta$ 出发要先两边乘 $r$：$r^2 = 4r\sin\theta$，再换成 $x^2+y^2 = 4y$。直接写成 $r = 4\sin\theta \Rightarrow y = \sqrt{x^2+y^2}\,\sin\theta$ 很难看清结果；反之把 $x^2+y^2=4y$ 平方还原时容易多出 $x^2+y^2=-4y$ 这一支，必须检查符号。
body.en: Starting from $r = 4\sin\theta$, first multiply both sides by $r$: $r^2 = 4r\sin\theta$, then replace by $x^2+y^2 = 4y$. Writing $y = \sqrt{x^2+y^2}\,\sin\theta$ hides the result; conversely, when squaring back from $x^2+y^2=4y$ one can pick up the spurious branch $x^2+y^2=-4y$, so the signs must be checked.

title.zh: 只令两极方程相等，漏掉极点的交点
title.en: Equating Two Polar Equations and Missing the Intersection at the Pole

body.zh: 习题 2.16 中两条心脏线都通过极点 $(0,0)$，但 $r=2+2\cos\theta$ 与 $r=2+2\sin\theta$ 相等只给出 $\cos\theta=\sin\theta$（即 $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{4},\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$）两个非极点交点；必须另外检查 $r=0$。习题 2.17 中同理，$r=3\cos\theta$ 与 $r=1+\cos\theta$ 在 $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{2},\pi$ 时都给出 $r=0$，故 $(0,0)$ 也是交点。
body.en: In Exercise 2.16 both cardioids pass through the pole $(0,0)$, but equating $r=2+2\cos\theta$ with $r=2+2\sin\theta$ only gives $\cos\theta=\sin\theta$ (i.e. $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{4},\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$); one must separately check $r=0$. The same applies in Exercise 2.17: $r=3\cos\theta$ and $r=1+\cos\theta$ both give $r=0$ at $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{2},\pi$, so $(0,0)$ is an intersection as well.

q.zh: 消去参数 $x = t^2,\ y = t^3,\ -2 \le t \le 2$ 中的参数，并画出其图象。
q.en: Eliminate the parameter in $x = t^2,\ y = t^3,\ -2 \le t \le 2$, and sketch its graph.

ans.zh: 消去参数后得 $x^3 = y^2$，且 $0 \le x \le 4$、$-8 \le y \le 8$（$y$ 轴右侧开口向右的半立方抛物线，顶点为原点）。
ans.en: Eliminating the parameter gives $x^3 = y^2$ with $0 \le x \le 4$ and $-8 \le y \le 8$ (the half-cubical parabola opening to the right of the $y$-axis, with vertex at the origin).

steps.en: From $x = t^2$ we get $x^3 = t^6$; from $y = t^3$ we get $y^2 = t^6$.
Equating the two expressions gives $x^3 = y^2$.

steps.zh: 由 $x = t^2 \ge 0$ 知图象只在 $y$ 轴右侧，且 $x$ 最大为 $4$、$y$ 从 $-8$ 到 $8$。
steps.en: Since $x = t^2 \ge 0$ the graph lies to the right of the $y$-axis, with $x$ up to $4$ and $y$ running from $-8$ to $8$.

official.en: From $x = t^2$ we get $x^3 = t^6$ and from $y = t^3$ we get $y^2 = t^6$, so $x^3 = t^6 = y^2$; the table $t=-2,-1,0,1,2$ gives $(4,-8),(1,-1),(0,0),(1,1),(4,8)$ and the curve is sketched from these.

note.zh: 方程 $x^3=y^2$ 还有 $x<0$ 的左半支，但不在本题的参数范围内。
note.en: The equation $x^3=y^2$ also has a left branch with $x<0$, which is outside the given parameter range.

q.zh: 消去参数 $x = \sqrt{t},\ y = 1 - t,\ 0 \le t \le 16$ 中的参数，并画出其图象。
q.en: Eliminate the parameter in $x = \sqrt{t},\ y = 1 - t,\ 0 \le t \le 16$, and sketch its graph.

ans.en: $y = 1 - x^2$ with $0 \le x \le 4$ (a downward-opening parabolic arc from $(0,1)$ to $(4,-15)$).

steps.en: From $x = \sqrt{t}$ we get $x^2 = t$.
Substituting into $y = 1 - t$ gives $x^2 = t = 1 - y$, i.e. $y = 1 - x^2$.
From $0 \le t \le 16$ we get $0 \le x \le 4$.

official.en: From $x = \sqrt{t}$ we get $x^2 = t$; substituting into $y = 1 - t$ gives $x^2 = t = 1 - y$, so $y = 1 - x^2$; the table $t=0,1,16$ gives $(0,1),(1,0),(4,-15)$ and the parabolic arc is sketched.

note.zh: 题面中的 $y=1-t$ 与 $0 \le t \le 16$ 在 PDF 文字层中显示为乱码，已按 Solutions PDF 页面渲染图逐字核对。
note.en: The printed $y=1-t$ and $0 \le t \le 16$ appear as mojibake in the PDF text layer; they were verified character by character against the rendered Solutions PDF page.

q.zh: 消去参数 $x = \sin 2t,\ y = \cos 4t,\ -\dfrac{\pi}{4} \le t \le \dfrac{\pi}{4}$ 中的参数，并画出其图象。
q.en: Eliminate the parameter in $x = \sin 2t,\ y = \cos 4t,\ -\dfrac{\pi}{4} \le t \le \dfrac{\pi}{4}$, and sketch its graph.

ans.en: $y = 1 - 2x^2$ with $-1 \le x \le 1$ (a downward-opening parabola with vertex $(0,1)$ passing through $(-1,-1)$ and $(1,-1)$).

steps.en: Use $\cos 2\theta = \cos^2\theta - \sin^2\theta = 1 - 2\sin^2\theta$.
Hence $y = \cos 4t = 1 - 2\sin^2 2t$.
Since $x = \sin 2t$, we get $y = 1 - 2x^2$.
From $-\dfrac{\pi}{4} \le t \le \dfrac{\pi}{4}$ we get $-\dfrac{\pi}{2} \le 2t \le \dfrac{\pi}{2}$, i.e. $-1 \le x \le 1$.

official.zh: 由 $\cos(A+B)=\cos A\cos B-\sin A\sin B$ 得 $\cos 2\theta = \cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta = 1-2\sin^2\theta$，故 $y = \cos 4t = 1-2\sin^2 2t = 1-2x^2$；列表 $t=-\dfrac{\pi}{4},0,\dfrac{\pi}{4}$ 对应 $(-1,-1),(0,1),(1,-1)$，并画出开口向下、顶点 $(0,1)$ 的抛物线。
official.en: From $\cos(A+B)=\cos A\cos B-\sin A\sin B$ we get $\cos 2\theta = \cos^2\theta-\sin^2\theta = 1-2\sin^2\theta$, so $y = \cos 4t = 1-2\sin^2 2t = 1-2x^2$; the table $t=-\dfrac{\pi}{4},0,\dfrac{\pi}{4}$ gives $(-1,-1),(0,1),(1,-1)$ and the downward-opening parabola with vertex $(0,1)$ is sketched.

type.zh: 由方程求参数方程（椭圆）
type.en: Find parametric equations from an equation (ellipse)

q.zh: 设 $a$ 与 $b$ 为正数。为曲线 $\dfrac{(x-h)^2}{a^2} + \dfrac{(y-k)^2}{b^2} = 1$ 求一组参数方程。
q.en: Let $a$ and $b$ be positive numbers. Find parametric equations for the curve $\dfrac{(x-h)^2}{a^2} + \dfrac{(y-k)^2}{b^2} = 1$.

ans.zh: $x = h + a\cos t,\ y = k + b\sin t,\ 0 \le t \le 2\pi$。
ans.en: $x = h + a\cos t,\ y = k + b\sin t,\ 0 \le t \le 2\pi$.

steps.en: Use the identity $\cos^2 t + \sin^2 t = 1$.
Set $\dfrac{x-h}{a} = \cos t$ and $\dfrac{y-k}{b} = \sin t$.

steps.zh: 解得 $x = h + a\cos t,\ y = k + b\sin t$，参数取 $0 \le t \le 2\pi$ 即可描出整条椭圆。
steps.en: This gives $x = h + a\cos t,\ y = k + b\sin t$; taking $0 \le t \le 2\pi$ traces the whole ellipse.

official.zh: 由 $\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta = 1$，令 $\dfrac{x-h}{a}=\cos\theta$，$\dfrac{y-k}{b}=\sin\theta$，得一组参数方程 $x = h + a\cos\theta,\ y = k + b\sin\theta,\ 0 \le \theta \le 2\pi$。
official.en: From $\cos^2\theta + \sin^2\theta = 1$, set $\dfrac{x-h}{a}=\cos\theta$ and $\dfrac{y-k}{b}=\sin\theta$; a pair of parametric equations is $x = h + a\cos\theta,\ y = k + b\sin\theta,\ 0 \le \theta \le 2\pi$.

type.zh: 由方程求参数方程（双曲线）
type.en: Find parametric equations from an equation (hyperbola)

q.zh: 设 $a$ 与 $b$ 为正数。为曲线 $\dfrac{(x-h)^2}{a^2} - \dfrac{(y-k)^2}{b^2} = 1$ 求一组参数方程。
q.en: Let $a$ and $b$ be positive numbers. Find parametric equations for the curve $\dfrac{(x-h)^2}{a^2} - \dfrac{(y-k)^2}{b^2} = 1$.

ans.zh: $x = h + a\cosh t,\ y = k + b\sinh t,\ t \in \mathbb{R}$（左支取 $x = h - a\cosh t$）；也可用 $x = h + a\sec t,\ y = k + b\tan t$。
ans.en: $x = h + a\cosh t,\ y = k + b\sinh t,\ t \in \mathbb{R}$ (the left branch uses $x = h - a\cosh t$); alternatively $x = h + a\sec t,\ y = k + b\tan t$.

steps.zh: 定义 $\cosh t = \dfrac{e^t + e^{-t}}{2}$，$\sinh t = \dfrac{e^t - e^{-t}}{2}$。
steps.en: Define $\cosh t = \dfrac{e^t + e^{-t}}{2}$ and $\sinh t = \dfrac{e^t - e^{-t}}{2}$.

steps.zh: 令 $\dfrac{x-h}{a} = \cosh t$，$\dfrac{y-k}{b} = \sinh t$，得 $x = h + a\cosh t,\ y = k + b\sinh t$，$t \in \mathbb{R}$ 给出右支；取 $x = h - a\cosh t$ 给出左支。
steps.en: Set $\dfrac{x-h}{a} = \cosh t$ and $\dfrac{y-k}{b} = \sinh t$, giving $x = h + a\cosh t,\ y = k + b\sinh t$; with $t \in \mathbb{R}$ this traces the right branch, and $x = h - a\cosh t$ gives the left branch.

steps.zh: 另一等价写法是利用 $\sec^2 t - \tan^2 t = 1$ 得 $x = h + a\sec t,\ y = k + b\tan t$（$-\dfrac{\pi}{2} < t < \dfrac{\pi}{2}$ 或 $\dfrac{\pi}{2} < t < \dfrac{3\pi}{2}$）。
steps.en: Equivalently, using $\sec^2 t - \tan^2 t = 1$ one gets $x = h + a\sec t,\ y = k + b\tan t$ (for $-\dfrac{\pi}{2} < t < \dfrac{\pi}{2}$ or $\dfrac{\pi}{2} < t < \dfrac{3\pi}{2}$).

official.zh: 定义 $\cosh\theta = \dfrac{e^\theta+e^{-\theta}}{2}$，$\sinh\theta = \dfrac{e^\theta-e^{-\theta}}{2}$ 并验证 $\cosh^2\theta-\sinh^2\theta = 1$；于是 $\dfrac{x-h}{a}=\cosh\theta$，$\dfrac{y-k}{b}=\sinh\theta$，即 $x = h+a\cosh\theta,\ y = k+b\sinh\theta$（$\theta \in \mathbb{R}$）以及 $x = h-a\cosh\theta,\ y = k+b\sinh\theta$；或用 $\sec^2\theta-\tan^2\theta=1$ 得 $x = h+a\sec\theta,\ y = k+b\tan\theta$。
official.en: Define $\cosh\theta = \dfrac{e^\theta+e^{-\theta}}{2}$ and $\sinh\theta = \dfrac{e^\theta-e^{-\theta}}{2}$ and verify $\cosh^2\theta-\sinh^2\theta = 1$; then $\dfrac{x-h}{a}=\cosh\theta$ and $\dfrac{y-k}{b}=\sinh\theta$, i.e. $x = h+a\cosh\theta,\ y = k+b\sinh\theta$ with $\theta \in \mathbb{R}$, together with $x = h-a\cosh\theta,\ y = k+b\sinh\theta$; alternatively, using $\sec^2\theta-\tan^2\theta=1$ gives $x = h+a\sec\theta,\ y = k+b\tan\theta$.

type.zh: 求两定点间线段的参数方程
type.en: Parametric equation of the segment joining two points

q.zh: 已知平面上两点 $P_1(x_1,y_1)$ 与 $P_2(x_2,y_2)$，求 $P_1$ 与 $P_2$ 之间线段的一条参数方程。
q.en: Given two points $P_1(x_1, y_1)$ and $P_2(x_2, y_2)$ on the plane, find a parametric equation for the line segment between $P_1$ and $P_2$.

steps.zh: 设 $P(x,y)$ 是线段上一点，则 $\dfrac{x-x_1}{x_2-x_1} = \dfrac{y-y_1}{y_2-y_1} = t$。
steps.en: Let $P(x,y)$ be a point on the segment, so $\dfrac{x-x_1}{x_2-x_1} = \dfrac{y-y_1}{y_2-y_1} = t$.
This gives $x - x_1 = t(x_2-x_1)$ and $y - y_1 = t(y_2-y_1)$.

steps.zh: 整理为 $x = (1-t)x_1 + t x_2$，$y = (1-t)y_1 + t y_2$；取 $0 \le t \le 1$ 才得到线段（而不是整条直线）。
steps.en: Rearranged: $x = (1-t)x_1 + t x_2$, $y = (1-t)y_1 + t y_2$; restricting to $0 \le t \le 1$ gives the segment rather than the whole line.

official.en: If $P$ is a point on the line segment then $x-x_1 = t(x_2-x_1)$ and $y-y_1 = t(y_2-y_1)$, i.e. $x = (1-t)x_1+tx_2$, $y = (1-t)y_1+ty_2$, $0 \le t \le 1$.

type.zh: 建立实际问题的参数方程（摆线）
type.en: Set up parametric equations from a physical model (cycloid)

q.zh: 摆线是轮子沿直线无滑动滚动时，轮缘上一点 $P$ 描出的曲线。设轮子半径为 $a$，求摆线的一对参数方程。
q.en: A cycloid is the curve traced by a point $P$ on the rim of a wheel as the wheel rolls along a straight line without slipping. Assume that the radius of the wheel is $a$. Find a pair of parametric equations for the cycloid.

steps.zh: 设 $C$ 为轮心，取参数 $\theta$ 为 $CP$ 与正 $x$ 轴所成的角；$P$ 初始位于原点，轮子沿正 $x$ 轴滚动。
steps.en: Let $C$ be the centre of the wheel and take $\theta$ as the angle that $CP$ makes with the positive $x$-axis; $P$ starts at the origin and the wheel rolls along the positive $x$-axis.

steps.zh: 此时 $CP$ 与正 $x$ 轴所成的角为 $\dfrac{3\pi}{2}-\theta$。
steps.en: Then the angle that $CP$ makes with the positive $x$-axis is $\dfrac{3\pi}{2}-\theta$.

steps.zh: 无滑动滚动意味着轮心平移距离等于转过的弧长 $a\theta$，故轮心位于 $(a\theta,\ a)$。
steps.en: Rolling without slipping means the centre translates by the arc length $a\theta$, so the centre is at $(a\theta,\ a)$.

steps.zh: 于是 $x = a\theta + a\cos\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = a\theta - a\sin\theta$，$y = a + a\sin\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = a - a\cos\theta$。
steps.en: Hence $x = a\theta + a\cos\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = a\theta - a\sin\theta$ and $y = a + a\sin\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = a - a\cos\theta$.

official.zh: 设 $C$ 为轮心，$P$ 初始位于原点，轮子沿正 $x$ 轴滚动；取参数 $\theta$ 为 $CP$ 与正 $x$ 轴所成的角，则 $CP$ 与正 $x$ 轴所成角为 $\dfrac{3\pi}{2}-\theta$。当参数为 $\theta$ 时轮心移动到点 $(a\theta,\ a)$，故 $x = a\theta + a\cos\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = a\theta - a\sin\theta$，$y = a + a\sin\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = a - a\cos\theta$。
official.en: Let $C$ be the centre of the wheel; $P$ starts at the origin and the wheel rolls along the positive $x$-axis. Take $\theta$ as the angle that $CP$ makes with the positive $x$-axis, so that angle is $\dfrac{3\pi}{2}-\theta$. When the parameter is $\theta$ the centre has moved to $(a\theta,\ a)$, so $x = a\theta + a\cos\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = a\theta - a\sin\theta$ and $y = a + a\sin\left(\dfrac{3\pi}{2}-\theta\right) = a - a\cos\theta$.

type.zh: 极曲线化为直角方程并作图
type.en: Convert a polar curve to a Cartesian equation and sketch

q.zh: 求极曲线 $r\sin\theta - 4r\cos\theta = 8$ 的直角坐标方程，并画出该曲线。
q.en: Find the Cartesian equation of the polar curve $r\sin\theta - 4r\cos\theta = 8$. Then sketch the curve.

ans.en: $y - 4x = 8$ (a straight line of slope $4$ passing through $(0,8)$).

steps.en: Use $r\sin\theta = y$ and $r\cos\theta = x$.
Substitution gives $y - 4x = 8$.
Sketch: the line meets the $y$-axis at $(0,8)$ and the $x$-axis at $(-2,0)$, with slope $4$.

official.zh: 由 $r\sin\theta = y$、$r\cos\theta = x$ 得 $y - 4x = 8$；并画出斜率为正的直线，经过 $y$ 轴上截距 $8$（即过 $(0,8)$）并与负 $x$ 轴相交。
official.en: Using $r\sin\theta = y$ and $r\cos\theta = x$ gives $y - 4x = 8$; the sketch is a line of positive slope passing through the $y$-intercept $8$ (i.e. through $(0,8)$) and crossing the negative $x$-axis.

type.zh: 极曲线化为直角方程并作图
type.en: Convert a polar curve to a Cartesian equation and sketch

q.zh: 求极曲线 $r = 4\sin\theta$ 的直角坐标方程，并画出该曲线。
q.en: Find the Cartesian equation of the polar curve $r = 4\sin\theta$. Then sketch the curve.

ans.en: $x^2 + (y-2)^2 = 4$ (circle with centre $(0,2)$ and radius $2$, tangent to the $x$-axis at the origin).

steps.en: Multiply both sides by $r$: $r^2 = 4r\sin\theta$.
Using $r^2 = x^2+y^2$ and $r\sin\theta = y$ gives $x^2+y^2 = 4y$.
Completing the square gives $x^2 + (y-2)^2 = 4$.
Sketch: centre $(0,2)$, radius $2$, passing through $(0,0)$ and $(0,4)$ and tangent to the $x$-axis at the origin.

official.zh: $r^2 = 4r\sin\theta$，$x^2+y^2 = 4y$，$x^2+(y-2)^2 = 4$；并画出圆心在正 $y$ 轴上 $(0,2)$、半径 $2$、过原点并在原点与 $x$ 轴相切的圆。
official.en: $r^2 = 4r\sin\theta$, $x^2+y^2 = 4y$, $x^2+(y-2)^2 = 4$; the sketch is the circle centred on the positive $y$-axis at $(0,2)$ with radius $2$, passing through the origin and tangent to the $x$-axis there.

type.zh: 极曲线化为直角方程并作图
type.en: Convert a polar curve to a Cartesian equation and sketch

q.zh: 求极曲线 $r = 6\sin\theta - 4\cos\theta$ 的直角坐标方程，并画出该曲线。
q.en: Find the Cartesian equation of the polar curve $r = 6\sin\theta - 4\cos\theta$. Then sketch the curve.

ans.en: $(x+2)^2 + (y-3)^2 = 13$ (circle with centre $(-2,3)$ and radius $\sqrt{13}$, passing through the origin).

steps.en: Multiply both sides by $r$: $r^2 = 6r\sin\theta - 4r\cos\theta$.

steps.zh: 用 $r^2 = x^2+y^2$、$r\sin\theta = y$、$r\cos\theta = x$ 得 $x^2+y^2 = 6y - 4x$。
steps.en: Using $r^2 = x^2+y^2$, $r\sin\theta = y$ and $r\cos\theta = x$ gives $x^2+y^2 = 6y - 4x$.
Sketch: centre $(-2,3)$, radius $\sqrt{13}$, passing through the origin $(0,0)$.

official.en: $r^2 = 6r\sin\theta - 4r\cos\theta$, $x^2+y^2 = 6y - 4x$, $(x+2)^2 + (y-3)^2 = 2^2+3^2 = 13$; the sketch is the circle centred at $(-2,3)$ and passing through the origin $(0,0)$.

type.zh: 极曲线化为直角方程并作图
type.en: Convert a polar curve to a Cartesian equation and sketch

q.zh: 求极曲线 $r^2\sin 2\theta = 1$ 的直角坐标方程，并画出该曲线。
q.en: Find the Cartesian equation of the polar curve $r^2\sin 2\theta = 1$. Then sketch the curve.

ans.zh: $xy = \dfrac{1}{2}$，但只取第一象限与第三象限的两支（因 $\sin 2\theta > 0$，即 $0<\theta<\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ 或 $\pi<\theta<\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$）。
ans.en: $xy = \dfrac{1}{2}$, but only the first- and third-quadrant branches are traced (since $\sin 2\theta > 0$, i.e. $0<\theta<\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ or $\pi<\theta<\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$).

steps.en: Use $\sin 2\theta = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta$.
This gives $2r^2\sin\theta\cos\theta = 1$.
Using $r\sin\theta = y$ and $r\cos\theta = x$ gives $2xy = 1$, i.e. $xy = \dfrac{1}{2}$.

steps.zh: 由原式右边为正知 $\sin 2\theta > 0$，即 $0<2\theta<\pi$ 或 $2\pi<2\theta<3\pi$，故 $\dfrac{\pi}{2}<\theta<\pi$ 不成立而 $0<\theta<\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ 与 $\pi<\theta<\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$ 成立。
steps.en: Since the right-hand side of the original equation is positive we need $\sin 2\theta > 0$, i.e. $0<2\theta<\pi$ or $2\pi<2\theta<3\pi$, so $0<\theta<\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ or $\pi<\theta<\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$.

steps.zh: 作图：等轴双曲线 $xy=\dfrac{1}{2}$ 在第一象限与第三象限的部分，以 $x$ 轴与 $y$ 轴为渐近线。
steps.en: Sketch: the rectangular hyperbola $xy=\dfrac{1}{2}$ in the first and third quadrants, asymptotic to both the $x$-axis and the $y$-axis.

official.zh: $\sin 2\theta = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta$，$2r^2\sin\theta\cos\theta = 1$，$2xy = 1$，$xy = \dfrac{1}{2}$；并由 $\sin 2\theta > 0$ 得 $0<2\theta<\pi \Rightarrow 0<\theta<\dfrac{\pi}{2}$，$2\pi<2\theta<3\pi \Rightarrow \pi<\theta<\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$；图示为位于第一、第三象限、以两坐标轴为渐近线的等轴双曲线。
official.en: $\sin 2\theta = 2\sin\theta\cos\theta$, $2r^2\sin\theta\cos\theta = 1$, $2xy = 1$, $xy = \dfrac{1}{2}$; from $\sin 2\theta > 0$ we get $0<2\theta<\pi \Rightarrow 0<\theta<\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ and $2\pi<2\theta<3\pi \Rightarrow \pi<\theta<\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$; the sketch is the rectangular hyperbola in the first and third quadrants, asymptotic to both axes.

type.zh: 用极坐标不等式描述区域并作图
type.en: Sketch a region described by polar inequalities

q.zh: 画出平面上所有满足极坐标条件 $3 < r \le 5,\ \dfrac{\pi}{3} \le \theta \le \dfrac{5\pi}{4}$ 的点所组成的区域。
q.en: Sketch the region in the plane consisting of points whose polar coordinates satisfy $3 < r \le 5,\ \dfrac{\pi}{3} \le \theta \le \dfrac{5\pi}{4}$.

ans.zh: 一个环形扇域：内边界是半径 $3$ 的圆弧（$r>3$，故画成虚线），外边界是半径 $5$ 的圆弧（$r \le 5$，画成实线），角度自 $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ 逆时针扫到 $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$。
ans.en: An annular sector: the inner boundary is the arc $r=3$ (since $r>3$ it is drawn dashed), the outer boundary is the arc $r=5$ ($r \le 5$, drawn solid), sweeping counterclockwise from $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ to $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$.

steps.zh: $3 < r \le 5$ 表示半径介于 $3$ 与 $5$ 之间的点。
steps.en: $3 < r \le 5$ describes the points whose distance from the pole lies between $3$ and $5$.

steps.zh: $\dfrac{\pi}{3} \le \theta \le \dfrac{5\pi}{4}$ 表示从与正 $x$ 轴成 $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ 角的射线起，逆时针转过 $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}-\dfrac{\pi}{3}=\dfrac{11\pi}{12}$。
steps.en: $\dfrac{\pi}{3} \le \theta \le \dfrac{5\pi}{4}$ means sweeping counterclockwise from the ray making angle $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ with the positive $x$-axis through $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}-\dfrac{\pi}{3}=\dfrac{11\pi}{12}$.

steps.zh: 内边界 $r=3$ 因严格不等号而用虚线，外边界 $r=5$ 因含等号而用实线，两条边界射线都包含在内。
steps.en: The inner boundary $r=3$ is dashed because of the strict inequality and the outer boundary $r=5$ is solid because equality is allowed; both bounding rays are included.

steps.zh: 在两圆弧之间、两条射线之间画出阴影即为所求区域。
steps.en: Shading between the two arcs and between the two rays gives the required region.

official.zh: 作图：画出角度为 $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ 的射线（第一象限）与 $\theta=\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$ 的射线（第三象限）；内边界画半径 $r=3$ 的虚线圆弧（对应严格不等式 $r>3$），外边界画半径 $r=5$ 的实线圆弧（对应 $r \le 5$）；两圆弧之间自 $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ 逆时针到 $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$ 的部分用阴影标出。
official.en: Sketch: the ray $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ in the first quadrant and the ray $\theta=\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$ in the third quadrant; the inner boundary is the dashed circular arc $r=3$ (the strict inequality $r>3$) and the outer boundary the solid arc $r=5$ ($r \le 5$); the region between the arcs, swept counterclockwise from $\dfrac{\pi}{3}$ to $\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$, is hatched.

type.zh: 用极坐标不等式描述区域并作图
type.en: Sketch a region described by polar inequalities

q.zh: 画出平面上所有满足极坐标条件 $0 \le \theta \le \pi,\ 3 \le r \le 6 + 3\cos\theta$ 的点所组成的区域。
q.en: Sketch the region in the plane consisting of points whose polar coordinates satisfy $0 \le \theta \le \pi,\ 3 \le r \le 6 + 3\cos\theta$.

ans.zh: 上半平面（$y \ge 0$）中，位于圆 $r=3$ 与 limacon 曲线 $r=6+3\cos\theta$ 之间的区域；外边界在 $\theta=0$ 处为 $(9,0)$，在 $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ 处为 $(0,6)$，在 $\theta=\pi$ 处与内圆相接于 $(-3,0)$。
ans.en: The region in the upper half-plane ($y \ge 0$) lying between the circle $r=3$ and the limaçon $r=6+3\cos\theta$; the outer boundary passes through $(9,0)$ at $\theta=0$, $(0,6)$ at $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ and meets the inner circle at $(-3,0)$ for $\theta=\pi$.

steps.zh: 内边界 $r=3$ 是以极点为圆心、半径 $3$ 的圆，经过 $(3,0)$。
steps.en: The inner boundary $r=3$ is the circle of radius $3$ centred at the pole, passing through $(3,0)$.

steps.zh: 外边界 $r=6+3\cos\theta$ 是 limacon：$\theta=0$ 时 $r=9$（过 $(9,0)$），$\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ 时 $r=6$，$\theta=\pi$ 时 $r=3$。
steps.en: The outer boundary $r=6+3\cos\theta$ is a limaçon: $r=9$ at $\theta=0$ (through $(9,0)$), $r=6$ at $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$, and $r=3$ at $\theta=\pi$.

steps.zh: $0 \le \theta \le \pi$ 把区域限制在上半平面 $y \ge 0$。
steps.en: $0 \le \theta \le \pi$ restricts the region to the upper half-plane $y \ge 0$.

steps.zh: 把圆与 limacon 之间（$r$ 从 $3$ 到 $6+3\cos\theta$）的上半部分用阴影标出。
steps.en: Shade the part between the circle and the limaçon ($r$ from $3$ to $6+3\cos\theta$) in the upper half-plane.

official.zh: 内边界 $r=3$ 是以极点为圆心、半径 $3$ 的圆，经过 $(3,0)$；外边界 $r=6+3\cos\theta$ 是 limacon：$\theta=0$ 时 $r=9$ 过 $(9,0)$，$\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ 时 $r=6$，$\theta=\pi$ 时 $r=3$ 并与内圆相交；$0 \le \theta \le \pi$ 把区域限制在上半平面 $y \ge 0$，圆与 limacon 之间的部分用阴影标出。
official.en: The inner boundary $r=3$ is the circle of radius $3$ centred at the pole through $(3,0)$; the outer boundary $r=6+3\cos\theta$ is a limaçon with $r=9$ at $\theta=0$ (through $(9,0)$), $r=6$ at $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ and $r=3$ at $\theta=\pi$, where it meets the inner circle; $0 \le \theta \le \pi$ restricts the region to the upper half-plane $y \ge 0$, and the part between the circle and the limaçon is hatched.

type.zh: 求两点间距离（给定极坐标）
type.en: Distance between two points given in polar coordinates

q.zh: 求极坐标为 $\left(4,\dfrac{4\pi}{3}\right)$ 与 $\left(6,\dfrac{5\pi}{3}\right)$ 的两点之间的距离。
q.en: Find the distance between the two points with polar coordinates $\left(4,\dfrac{4\pi}{3}\right)$ and $\left(6,\dfrac{5\pi}{3}\right)$.

steps.en: Convert to Cartesian: $P_1 = (4\cos\tfrac{4\pi}{3},\ 4\sin\tfrac{4\pi}{3}) = (-2,\ -2\sqrt{3})$.
By the distance formula: $d = \sqrt{(3-(-2))^2 + (-3\sqrt{3}+2\sqrt{3})^2}$.
Simplifying, $d = \sqrt{25 + 3} = \sqrt{28}$.

official.en: Convert to Cartesian $P_1=(-2,-2\sqrt{3})$ and $P_2=(3,-3\sqrt{3})$, then the distance formula gives $\sqrt{(3+2)^2+(-3\sqrt{3}+2\sqrt{3})^2}=\sqrt{25+3}=\sqrt{28}$.

note.zh: 手册最后一行手写数字形似「38」，但其推导为 $\sqrt{25+3}$，正确值为 $\sqrt{28}$。
note.en: The last handwritten line in the manual looks like 38, but the manual's own working gives $\sqrt{25+3}$, so the correct value is $\sqrt{28}$.

type.zh: 推导两点间距离的一般公式
type.en: Derive the general distance formula in polar coordinates

q.zh: 求极坐标为 $(r_1,\theta_1)$ 与 $(r_2,\theta_2)$ 的两点之间距离的公式。
q.en: Find a formula for the distance between the two points with polar coordinates $(r_1,\theta_1)$ and $(r_2,\theta_2)$.

steps.zh: 把极坐标写成直角坐标：$(r_1,\theta_1)$ 即 $(r_1\cos\theta_1,\ r_1\sin\theta_1)$，$(r_2,\theta_2)$ 即 $(r_2\cos\theta_2,\ r_2\sin\theta_2)$。
steps.en: Write the polar coordinates in Cartesian form: $(r_1,\theta_1)$ is $(r_1\cos\theta_1,\ r_1\sin\theta_1)$ and $(r_2,\theta_2)$ is $(r_2\cos\theta_2,\ r_2\sin\theta_2)$.
By the distance formula: $d = \sqrt{(r_1\cos\theta_1 - r_2\cos\theta_2)^2 + (r_1\sin\theta_1 - r_2\sin\theta_2)^2}$.
Expanding: $d = \sqrt{r_1^2\cos^2\theta_1 - 2r_1r_2\cos\theta_1\cos\theta_2 + r_2^2\cos^2\theta_2 + r_1^2\sin^2\theta_1 - 2r_1r_2\sin\theta_1\sin\theta_2 + r_2^2\sin^2\theta_2}$.
Using $\cos^2+\sin^2=1$ and $\cos\theta_1\cos\theta_2+\sin\theta_1\sin\theta_2=\cos(\theta_1-\theta_2)$ gives $d = \sqrt{r_1^2 + r_2^2 - 2r_1r_2\cos(\theta_1-\theta_2)}$.

official.zh: $(r_1,\theta_1)$ 的直角坐标为 $(r_1\cos\theta_1,\ r_1\sin\theta_1)$，$(r_2,\theta_2)$ 的直角坐标为 $(r_2\cos\theta_2,\ r_2\sin\theta_2)$；两点距离为 $\sqrt{(r_1\cos\theta_1-r_2\cos\theta_2)^2+(r_1\sin\theta_1-r_2\sin\theta_2)^2}$，展开并用 $\cos\theta_1\cos\theta_2+\sin\theta_1\sin\theta_2=\cos(\theta_1-\theta_2)$ 化简得 $\sqrt{r_1^2+r_2^2-2r_1r_2\cos(\theta_1-\theta_2)}$。
official.en: The Cartesian coordinates of $(r_1,\theta_1)$ are $(r_1\cos\theta_1,\ r_1\sin\theta_1)$ and of $(r_2,\theta_2)$ are $(r_2\cos\theta_2,\ r_2\sin\theta_2)$; the distance is $\sqrt{(r_1\cos\theta_1-r_2\cos\theta_2)^2+(r_1\sin\theta_1-r_2\sin\theta_2)^2}$, which expands and, using $\cos\theta_1\cos\theta_2+\sin\theta_1\sin\theta_2=\cos(\theta_1-\theta_2)$, simplifies to $\sqrt{r_1^2+r_2^2-2r_1r_2\cos(\theta_1-\theta_2)}$.

type.en: Find the intersections of two polar curves

q.zh: 求两条心脏线 $r = 2 + 2\cos\theta$ 与 $r = 2 + 2\sin\theta$ 的交点。
q.en: Find the points of intersection of the two cardioids $r = 2 + 2\cos\theta$ and $r = 2 + 2\sin\theta$.

steps.zh: 先看极点：当 $\theta=\pi$ 时 $r = 2+2\cos\pi = 0$，曲线 $r=2+2\cos\theta$ 过 $(0,0)$。
steps.en: First the pole: at $\theta=\pi$, $r = 2+2\cos\pi = 0$, so the curve $r=2+2\cos\theta$ passes through $(0,0)$.

steps.zh: 当 $\theta=\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$ 时 $r = 2+2\sin\dfrac{3\pi}{2} = 0$，曲线 $r=2+2\sin\theta$ 也过 $(0,0)$。
steps.en: At $\theta=\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$, $r = 2+2\sin\dfrac{3\pi}{2} = 0$, so $r=2+2\sin\theta$ also passes through $(0,0)$.

steps.zh: 故 $(0,0)$ 是两曲线的交点。
steps.en: Hence $(0,0)$ is an intersection point of the two curves.
For $r \neq 0$: $2+2\cos\theta = 2+2\sin\theta$, i.e. $\cos\theta = \sin\theta$, giving $\theta = \dfrac{\pi}{4},\ \dfrac{5\pi}{4}$.

steps.zh: 此时 $\cos\theta=\sin\theta = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ 或 $-\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$，$r = 2+\sqrt{2}$ 或 $2-\sqrt{2}$，故 $r\cos\theta = r\sin\theta = \sqrt{2}+1$ 或 $-\sqrt{2}+1$。
steps.en: Then $\cos\theta=\sin\theta = \dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ or $-\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$, $r = 2+\sqrt{2}$ or $2-\sqrt{2}$, so $r\cos\theta = r\sin\theta = \sqrt{2}+1$ or $-\sqrt{2}+1$.

official.zh: 当 $\theta=\pi$ 时 $r = 2+2\cos\pi = 0$，曲线 $r=2+2\cos\theta$ 过 $(0,0)$；当 $\theta=\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$ 时 $r = 2+2\sin\dfrac{3\pi}{2} = 0$，曲线 $r=2+2\sin\theta$ 也过 $(0,0)$，故 $(0,0)$ 是两曲线交点。对 $r\neq 0$：$2+2\cos\theta = 2+2\sin\theta$，$\cos\theta=\sin\theta$，得 $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{4},\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$；$\cos\theta=\sin\theta=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}},-\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$，$r = 2+\sqrt{2},\ 2-\sqrt{2}$，$r\cos\theta = r\sin\theta = \sqrt{2}+1,\ -\sqrt{2}+1$。故交点为 $(0,0)$，$(\sqrt{2}+1,\sqrt{2}+1)$，$(-\sqrt{2}+1,-\sqrt{2}+1)$。
official.en: At $\theta=\pi$, $r = 2+2\cos\pi = 0$, so $r=2+2\cos\theta$ passes through $(0,0)$; at $\theta=\dfrac{3\pi}{2}$, $r = 2+2\sin\dfrac{3\pi}{2} = 0$, so $r=2+2\sin\theta$ also passes through $(0,0)$; hence $(0,0)$ is an intersection. For $r \neq 0$: $2+2\cos\theta = 2+2\sin\theta$ gives $\cos\theta=\sin\theta$, hence $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{4},\dfrac{5\pi}{4}$; with $\cos\theta=\sin\theta=\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}},-\dfrac{1}{\sqrt{2}}$ and $r = 2+\sqrt{2},\ 2-\sqrt{2}}$, we get $r\cos\theta = r\sin\theta = \sqrt{2}+1,\ -\sqrt{2}+1$. Hence the intersection points are $(0,0)$, $(\sqrt{2}+1,\sqrt{2}+1)$ and $(-\sqrt{2}+1,-\sqrt{2}+1)$.

type.zh: 求两曲线的交点与区域作图
type.en: Intersections of two curves and sketching a region

q.zh: 画出位于曲线 $r = 3\cos\theta$ 内部、曲线 $r = 1+\cos\theta$ 外部的区域，并求两曲线的交点。
q.en: Sketch the region inside the curve $r = 3\cos\theta$ and outside the curve $r = 1+\cos\theta$, and find the points of intersection of the curves.

ans.zh: 交点为 $(0,0)$、$\left(\dfrac{3}{4},\dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4}\right)$ 与 $\left(\dfrac{3}{4},-\dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4}\right)$；所求区域为圆 $r=3\cos\theta$（圆心 $(\dfrac{3}{2},0)$、半径 $\dfrac{3}{2}$）内部且心脏线 $r=1+\cos\theta$ 外部的部分。
ans.en: The intersection points are $(0,0)$, $\left(\dfrac{3}{4},\dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4}\right)$ and $\left(\dfrac{3}{4},-\dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4}\right)$; the region is the part inside the circle $r=3\cos\theta$ (centre $(\dfrac{3}{2},0)$, radius $\dfrac{3}{2}$) and outside the cardioid $r=1+\cos\theta$.

steps.zh: $r=3\cos\theta$ 是圆心 $(\dfrac{3}{2},0)$、半径 $\dfrac{3}{2}$ 的圆；$r=1+\cos\theta$ 是心脏线。
steps.en: $r=3\cos\theta$ is a circle with centre $(\dfrac{3}{2},0)$ and radius $\dfrac{3}{2}$; $r=1+\cos\theta$ is a cardioid.
At $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$, $r = 3\cos\dfrac{\pi}{2} = 0$, so $r=3\cos\theta$ passes through $(0,0)$.

steps.zh: 当 $\theta=\pi$ 时 $r = 1+\cos\pi = 0$，曲线 $r=1+\cos\theta$ 也过 $(0,0)$，故 $(0,0)$ 是交点。
steps.en: At $\theta=\pi$, $r = 1+\cos\pi = 0$, so $r=1+\cos\theta$ also passes through $(0,0)$; hence $(0,0)$ is an intersection point.
For $r \neq 0$: $3\cos\theta = 1+\cos\theta$, i.e. $\cos\theta = \dfrac{1}{2}$, giving $\theta = \dfrac{\pi}{3},\ \dfrac{5\pi}{3}$.
Then $r = \dfrac{3}{2}$, $r\cos\theta = \dfrac{3}{4}$ and $r\sin\theta = \dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4}$ or $-\dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4}$.

steps.zh: 在图中标出圆 $r=3\cos\theta$ 与心脏线 $r=1+\cos\theta$，阴影部分为圆内、心脏线外的区域。
steps.en: On the sketch mark the circle $r=3\cos\theta$ and the cardioid $r=1+\cos\theta$; the shaded part is inside the circle and outside the cardioid.

official.zh: $r=3\cos\theta$ 是圆心 $(\dfrac{3}{2},0)$、半径 $3$ 的圆，$r=1+\cos\theta$ 是心脏线。当 $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$ 时 $r=3\cos\dfrac{\pi}{2}=0$，$r=3\cos\theta$ 过 $(0,0)$；当 $\theta=\pi$ 时 $r=1+\cos\pi=0$，$r=1+\cos\theta$ 也过 $(0,0)$，故 $(0,0)$ 是两曲线交点。对 $r\neq 0$：$3\cos\theta = 1+\cos\theta$，得 $\cos\theta=\dfrac{1}{2}$，$\theta=-\dfrac{\pi}{3},\dfrac{\pi}{3}$；$r=\dfrac{3}{2},\dfrac{3}{2}$；$\cos\theta=-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2},\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$；$r\cos\theta=\dfrac{3}{4},\dfrac{3}{4}$；$r\sin\theta=-\dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4},\dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4}$。故交点为 $(0,0)$，$(\dfrac{3}{4},-\dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4})$，$(\dfrac{3}{4},\dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4})$；并画出位于 $r=3\cos\theta$ 内、$r=1+\cos\theta$ 外的区域。
official.en: $r=3\cos\theta$ is a circle with centre $(\dfrac{3}{2},0)$ and radius $3$, and $r=1+\cos\theta$ is a cardioid. At $\theta=\dfrac{\pi}{2}$, $r=3\cos\dfrac{\pi}{2}=0$, so $r=3\cos\theta$ passes through $(0,0)$; at $\theta=\pi$, $r=1+\cos\pi=0$, so $r=1+\cos\theta$ also passes through $(0,0)$; hence $(0,0)$ is an intersection of the two curves. For $r \neq 0$: $3\cos\theta = 1+\cos\theta$ gives $\cos\theta=\dfrac{1}{2}$, so $\theta=-\dfrac{\pi}{3},\dfrac{\pi}{3}$; $r=\dfrac{3}{2},\dfrac{3}{2}$; $\cos\theta=-\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2},\dfrac{\sqrt{3}}{2}$; $r\cos\theta=\dfrac{3}{4},\dfrac{3}{4}$; $r\sin\theta=-\dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4},\dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4}$. Hence the intersection points are $(0,0)$, $(\dfrac{3}{4},-\dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4})$ and $(\dfrac{3}{4},\dfrac{3\sqrt{3}}{4})$; the region inside $r=3\cos\theta$ and outside $r=1+\cos\theta$ is sketched.

note.zh: 手册手写解答把 $r=3\cos\theta$ 说成「圆心 $(\dfrac{3}{2},0)$、半径 $3$ 的圆」，半径应为 $\dfrac{3}{2}$（由 $x^2+y^2=3x \Rightarrow (x-\dfrac{3}{2})^2+y^2=\dfrac{9}{4}$ 可得）。此处的 official 字段按手册原文转写，答案与步骤中采用正确半径 $\dfrac{3}{2}$。
note.en: The handwritten official solution calls $r=3\cos\theta$ a circle with centre $(\dfrac{3}{2},0)$ and radius $3$; the radius should be $\dfrac{3}{2}$ (from $x^2+y^2=3x \Rightarrow (x-\dfrac{3}{2})^2+y^2=\dfrac{9}{4}$). The official field transcribes the manual verbatim, while the answer and steps use the correct radius $\dfrac{3}{2}$.
